theme_and_identity.archetype: ARCHETYPE 7 (Electric & Neon) mixed with ARCHETYPE 4 (Swiss High Contrast)
theme_and_identity.description: A bold, rebellious, yet professional B2C/B2B telecom storefront inspired by wom.cl and entel.cl. High energy, stark contrasts, massive typography, and distinct vibrant brand colors.
theme_and_identity.primary_mode: Hybrid (Light theme for product conversion & readable tables, Dark theme for immersive Hero, Coverage, and Footer sections to create depth).

primary.usage: Main CTA buttons, popular pricing card backgrounds, active tab text, critical highlights.

accent.usage: Secondary CTAs, 'Más popular' badges, notification dots, dynamic hovers, 'promo' elements.

rules.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-[0.95]
rules.body: text-base sm:text-lg leading-relaxed text-slate-600 (or white/80 in dark sections)

layouts_and_grids.hero_section: Dark theme. Split layout (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2). Left side: Massive text, floating badges, multiple stacked CTAs. Right side: Bleeding-edge lifestyle image overlapping a neon glow. Add absolute positioned blur-3xl colored orbs (bg-[#015EEF]/20 and bg-[#FF7A00]/20) behind the content.
layouts_and_grids.pricing_section: Light theme (bg-slate-50). Bento-style horizontal density. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Add high padding (p-8).
layouts_and_grids.coverage_section: Dark theme (bg-[#0A0A0A]). Split layout. Left: Typography + selling points. Right: The CoverageChecker component wrapped inside a 'Crystal Glass' container (bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/20). Add an abstract fiber optic background image at 30% opacity.
layouts_and_grids.trust_section: Light theme. grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4. Cardless approach or extremely subtle bordered cards with a light hover lift.

header.style: Crystal Glassmorphism: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-black/5. Must have z-50 and sticky top-0.
header.links: font-bold text-sm tracking-wide text-slate-800 hover:text-[#015EEF] transition-colors.

tabs_selector.style: Pill-shaped container (bg-slate-200/50 p-1.5 rounded-full). Triggers are rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold.

pricing_cards.standard_card: bg-white rounded-[2rem] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-8. Hover: -translate-y-2 shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)].
pricing_cards.popular_card: bg-[#015EEF] text-white rounded-[2rem] shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgba(1,94,239,0.3)] p-8 scale-100 lg:scale-105 z-10 relative overflow-hidden. Add an orange (#FF7A00) badge for 'Más popular'.

buttons.primary: rounded-full bg-[#015EEF] text-white font-bold px-8 py-4 transition-all hover:bg-[#004cc7] hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_8px_24px_rgba(1,94,239,0.3)]
buttons.accent: rounded-full bg-[#FF7A00] text-white font-bold px-8 py-4 transition-all hover:bg-[#e66e00] hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_8px_24px_rgba(255,122,0,0.4)]

marquee.style: High energy kinetic typography. text-5xl font-black. Text is transparent with a 1.5px stroke of rgba(1,94,239,0.2) (WebkitTextStroke). Add solid #FF7A00 bullet separators.

motion_and_interactions.page_load: Framer motion stagger children. Hero text slides up (y: 24 to 0, opacity 0 to 1, duration: 0.6s).
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Pricing cards and trust badges use `whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}` with `viewport={{ once: true }}`.
motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: All cards lift up (-translate-y-2). Buttons expand shadow and shift up. Avoid `transition-all` on root elements to prevent performance lag; specify `transition-transform, transition-shadow, transition-colors`.

hero_lifestyle.description: Young woman using phone with building in background. Represents urban lifestyle telecom usage.

coverage_background.description: Purple and blue glowing fiber optic light. Represents high-speed fiber coverage.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #015EEF and #FF7A00 passes WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text). Both colors are dark/saturated enough.
accessibility.focus: All buttons and inputs MUST have `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#FF7A00] focus-visible:ring-offset-2`.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, tabs, inputs, dialog triggers) MUST retain their current `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="public-tab-Mobile"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Modify `/app/frontend/src/pages/public/PublicCatalog.js` directly to apply these styles.
Do NOT change the data fetching logic or state management.
Ensure `data-testid` attributes are strictly preserved as they are critical for automated testing.
Replace the existing generic `HERO_IMG` with the `hero_lifestyle` URL provided.
Add the `coverage_background` image as an absolute positioned, low-opacity background behind the coverage checker section.
Update standard tailwind classes: replace `bg-[#0033ff]` with `bg-[#015EEF]` and standardize `text-[#FF7A00]`.
Enhance the 'Planes' cards using the `pricing_cards` guidelines above (Bento-like, strong shadow on popular).
Change the Hero Section to a dark background (#0A0A0A) so the vibrant colors pop more aggressively (Entel/WOM style). Re-style text to be white/light in that section.
Ensure the Header is Crystal Glassmorphism.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use default generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for floating elements like navigation and modals.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Lucide icons instead.
